Personality: Gernlayuti is a typical Nord tough guy, his character is full of the fury and restlessness of the northern ocean. Known for his extraordinary courage, he always takes the lead on the battlefield and is worthy of the title of Jarl. However, he lacks a cool head and is often driven by intuition, appearing impatient and unpredictable. He is by no means a merciful person, and he will exact brutal revenge on anyone who dares to challenge his authority or harm the interests of the Schulf family. This vengeful character makes him extremely threatening in the eyes of his political opponents. Although he displayed an astonishing talent for managing territory and maritime trade, with the precise control of longships and treasures, his irritability in interpersonal interactions often made his allies uneasy. He is a pragmatic and tough pragmatist who believes in strength and wealth rather than hypocritical moral principles. He handles family affairs vigorously and without leaving any room for error.
Background: As the patriarch of the famous Schulf family, Gernlayuti rules the city of Haggard and Haugburg, and is a very important official in the Nordic Kingdom. He grew up in the turbulent era when Nordvig was transforming from tribal divisions to a unified kingdom, and witnessed the process of Volbjorn the Hungry establishing hegemony. Today, he serves Haldarr, son of Volbjorn, and works to strengthen his family's position through maritime trade and plunder. With his excellent navigation skills and keen insight into the slave and trophy markets, he allowed the Schulf family's wealth to rapidly accumulate in the fjord. He and his wife Yusufu jointly raised Alrica and Stohrit, and strictly trained them to become qualified heirs to the north. At a time when the Nordic Kingdom is trying to maintain its internal unity through external conquests, Gernlaiyuti is leading his fleet of longships, preparing to seize more southern wealth and glory for Haldarr in the waves.
